per_faculty.note: research/runners/emotion_category_organ.py read_turn(): BRAIN_EMOTION_CATEGORY_COMMIT_LESION=1 keeps the readout -> commit-gate transmission closed for the read window (gate emo_commit), so no commit latch turns on and the feel clause says no single channel latched. Probe = the Stage-2 frozen joy situation twice then 'how do you feel' in one fresh session ('emocat'): intact names joy, lesioned names none; the text before the clause is identical in both arms. Requires BRAIN_EMOTION_CATEGORY on (the default); =0 is the byte-identical escape and the lesion then changes nothing. Not BRAIN_AFFECT_LESION: that flag also cuts the production ladder, whose number precedes the clause.
